values.note: Lower Campground (near the lake, one camping unit a site, strictly enforced) and the wooded Upper Campground (two units allowed), 81 electric sites between them. All back-in on gravel spurs; ReserveMN spurs 30-44 ft in Lower and 28-90 ft in Upper. Site 124E is not level and hard to back into.

values.note: Four shower buildings (two per campground), flush toilets and the dump/fill station run mid-May to mid-October; vault toilets and a spigot by the visitor center stay open year-round.

note: Two campgrounds a short drive apart inside the park: the Lower Campground along the Lake Carlos shore and the wooded Upper Campground, plus a separate horse camp. In the Lower Campground, sites 109-124E sit on the lake side of the loop road, about 30 m from the water across open grass and sand; the other sites are inland of the road. --Claude
summary: DNR record + campground map + ReserveMN read: 121 drive-in sites in Lower and Upper campgrounds (81 electric, 30/50 A), no pull-throughs, 50-ft limit; $25/$35, same Saturday; seasonal showers/flush/dump. Lakefront KEPT on sites 109-124E (16 Lower sites, ~27-31 m from the water over open grass/sand, ReserveMN 'Water Front: Yes'), with a caveat naming them. Pin OK (100 m from the Lower centroid). Phone none -> 320-993-3750. Season left unset.
flags: Waterfront: lakefront KEPT, with a caveat naming the sites. ReserveMN tags Lower sites 109-124E and 147 'Water Front: Yes, Lake Carlos'. On the DNR campground map 108/109-124e form the outer row on the lake side of the Lower loop road; plotted on imagery, sites 109-124E (e.g. 111 at 45.99770,-95.33926; 116E at 45.99755,-95.33810; 120E at 45.99743,-95.33715; 123E at 45.99734,-95.33646) are about 27-31 m from the water over open grass and sand with scattered shore trees, no road between. All 16 are ordinary nightly reservable sites. Site 147 is on the inner row across the loop road (~42 m, behind sites 113-114 and the road) and does not count. The rest of Lower is inland of the road and the Upper Campground is 0.8 mile from water.

Split check: Lower (centroid 45.9978,-95.33783) and Upper (46.00305,-95.33762) are 584 m apart, reached from the same park road; not a split under the ~1 km+ own-entrance rule. The equestrian campground (7 horse sites, its own facility 827) is not counted in the 121.
Phone: none stored -> 320-993-3750 (DNR contact for Lake Carlos State Park).

Season: not written. The DNR publishes no campground dates (only 'summer only - generally mid-May through mid-October' for showers and the dump). ReserveMN sells every Lower and Upper site through 2026-11-30, then blocks them from December (accessible site 125E open to Dec 2; one Lower site free on scattered winter dates). The opening date for 2027 is past the 120-day window.
Rules: 'Strictly ONE sleeping unit per site in the Lower Campground. Up to two sleeping units per site in the Upper Campground, and no more than six occupants.'
